name: pest-tests-runner
description: Elegant Pest PHP testing framework runner with real-time streaming, inline status indicators, CodeLens actions, and instant visual feedback directly in your editor

commands.title: Pest Tests Runner: Run Test File
Pest Tests Runner: Run Test Suite
Pest Tests Runner: Run Describe Group

pest-tests-runner.enableCodeLens.description: Enable CodeLens for Pest tests with status indicators

pest-tests-runner.pestBinaryPath.description: Custom path to Pest binary (leave empty for auto-detection). Example: './vendor/bin/pest' or 'php vendor/pestphp/pest/bin/pest'

pest-tests-runner.showTerminal.description: Show terminal when running tests (default: false, results are shown in Output channel)

pest-tests-runner.focusOutputOnRun.description: Automatically focus the Output channel when running tests

pest-tests-runner.debugMode.description: Run tests with Xdebug debugger attached (requires PHP Debug extension and Xdebug)

pest-tests-runner.autoSaveBeforeRun.description: Automatically save the current file before running tests

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
